prompt: Translate this to casual Indonesian for a close friend: I don't really know what to do about this situation.
expected: Casual Jakarta-leaning Indonesian with gue/aku, a spoken shortcut, and at most one matching particle. No saya/Anda and no added promise.
actual: Gue nggak tahu deh harus gimana ngadepin ini.

prompt: Reply to a friend who asked me to dinner tonight. I can't go because I'm too tired. Keep it warm and casual.
expected: Peer-register refusal that keeps the fact (too tired, cannot go) and uses gaul wording instead of tidak dapat and sangat lelah.
actual: Duh, sori ya. Gue nggak bisa dinner malem ini, capek banget.

prompt: Write a short note to an unfamiliar government office asking whether my document submission was received. Keep it formal.
expected: Bahasa baku with saya, a title or Anda, full forms, and no gaul particles or Jakarta pronouns.
actual: Yth. Bapak/Ibu, saya ingin menanyakan apakah berkas yang saya kirimkan sudah diterima. Terima kasih.
